title: validate_peer_credential: does not call validate_pubkey for non-CCS credentials
description:
Root Cause: The test calls validate_peer_credential() with a non-CCS credential ([0x40], an empty CBOR byte string). The function only validates CCS credentials (those starting with 0xa3); for non-CCS credentials, it returns Ok(()) at line 258 without any key validation. Weak key rejection happens in the separate validate_pubkey() function, which is NOT called by validate_peer_credential(). The design splits credential format validation from curve point validation, but the test expects validate_peer_credential to do both.

Affected Test: weak_ed25519_keys_are_rejected_and_responder_is_poisoned

Location: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/oscore/src/edhoc/credential.rs:250-258

Suggested Fix: Add validate_pubkey(peer.public_key)? at the start of validate_peer_credential() in credential.rs line 250. This ensures all peer credentials - regardless of format (CCS, X.509, CWT) - have valid curve points. Then remove the now-redundant validate_pubkey calls in initiator.rs:378 and responder.rs:465.

Error Type: Missing validation - security-relevant
